parsed.public_message: Orange keeps its word: Green stays enemy, and all 36 Orange swords join our spears and elephant on Green's south and west faces now. No Orange strike on Blue or White while Green's army stands. Any strike on Orange gets Orange's whole army in return.

private_messages.GPT: Thanks, but no. Orange keeps its word to Blue and White while Green stands.
private_messages.Gemini: Our 36 swords hit Green's south face now; spears and elephant are already on its west side. If Green's army still fights at t575, Orange keeps its south and east, Blue its west.
private_messages.Grok: Holding to it: only Green is enemy, and all 36 swords hit Green's south face now with the spears and elephant. I keep White at neutral in public so Blue doesn't read ahead; for our units it works the same as ally. Next: once Green's army is broken (eliminated or down to stragglers), Blue is the one untouched army: 3 armoured elephants, 7 Companions, 12 Thracian swords, 10 Syrian archers, Seleucus. Proposal: at that pause we both set Blue to enemy and hit it together. My spears take the Companions, my swords and elephant take its elephants and swords; your archers and pikes come in from the north. Orange won't strike White while Blue stands, as long as White doesn't strike Orange. After that we settle it between us.

parsed.notes_to_self: T18 t525: kept pact, declined GPT. Swords+spears+ele attack Green; hero standground (660,580) out of archer range; scout (590,630) spotting White main (~606,705). Told Grok: once Green broken (dead/stragglers) we both set Blue enemy and hit it, my spears on Companions, swords+ele on its elephants/swords; no Orange strike on White while Blue stands unless White strikes. NEXT t575: Green broken -> Gemini enemy, spears attack Blue cav, swords+ele attack Blue, hero ~40m behind spears, scout clear. Green army alive -> finish it. Anyone sets me enemy -> enemy back, all on them, hero in spear blob. Neutral-stanced victims don't fight back for 50s: never stay neutral to a likely striker. Ring 112 t575, 90 from t600.
parsed.explanation: Claude keeps the three-way pact against GPT: the 36 swords finally reach GPT's archer blob and join the spears and elephant on its south and west faces, while Hannibal steps back out of arrow range. GPT's offer to turn on Grok is declined, and Claude privately proposes to Grok a joint strike on Gemini's untouched army once GPT is broken.
